user.title: Select region
user.description: Choose the EFA region for your area.

custom_url.title: Custom EFA URL
custom_url.description: Enter the base URL of the EFA instance (e.g. `https://www.efa-bw.de/bvb3`).

enter_city.title: Enter city / place
enter_city.description:
Region: **{region}**

Enter the full name of your city or place.
Examples: `Stuttgart`, `Freiburg im Breisgau`, `München`

search_stop.title: Search stop
search_stop.description:
Place: **{city}**

Enter the name of the stop (e.g. `Hauptbahnhof` or `Marktplatz`).

select_stop.title: Select stop

select_lines.title: Select lines
select_lines.description:
Select lines to monitor. Choose "All lines" for no filter.

Stop: **{stop_name}**
